zh-CN.name: 联网访问
zh-CN.summary: 联网搜索、网页抓取、内置受管浏览器登录态访问与取文、研究调研工作流
zh-CN.description: 联网访问工具包——搜索公开页面、Jina 优化抓取、内置受管浏览器完成登录态访问与取文，以及用户点名时接管他自己的 Chrome/Edge/Chromium。 外部浏览器需单独安装并满足其使用条款；提供启动工具的客户端可经审批启动，旧客户端需手动开启调试。 支持新客户端按显式路径审批启动系统浏览器；原生启动与 CDP 自动化就绪分别核验，依赖从随包资产离线准备。

en-US.name: Web Access
en-US.summary: Web search, page fetching, logged-in access via the governed built-in browser, research workflows
en-US.description: A web-access toolkit — search public pages, fetch heavy pages via Jina Reader, reach and read logged-in sites through the governed built-in browser, and drive the user's named Chrome/Edge/Chromium over CDP on request. The external browser is separately installed and subject to its usage terms; clients with the launch tool support approved startup, while older clients require manual debugging startup. New clients support approved native launch by explicit executable path; native startup and CDP automation readiness are verified separately, with automation dependencies prepared from bundled offline assets.
